resources.string: Example
Example, illustration only. %1$s
A book card for The Lantern Path and a short passage from its first chapter.
Reader controls with Contents, Aa, and Save, followed by a chapter list with the current chapter selected.
Reader settings with font size, line height, theme, and text alignment choices above a sample passage.
A book search with a sample query and Search book contents turned off.
A chapter-text search with a sample phrase and Search book contents turned on.
A matching chapter result with a passage excerpt and Open matching chapter.
Reader navigation with Save, which adds the book to My Books.
Continue reading for The Lantern Path, showing a saved reading position.
A saved book with chapters available after being loaded online. Saving alone does not download chapters.
Contents showing two available chapters and one chapter marked Not saved on this device.
Storage settings with only Offline reading cache selected and Clear selected caches. Clearing removes stored book content.
A short passage with one sentence highlighted, showing the result of creating a private highlight.
A private saved highlight with Open passage, Publish, and Delete actions.
A highlight publication form with the quoted passage, an optional comment, and Publish highlight. Publication shares it publicly.
The book action Rate and review.
A review form with four stars selected, a sample opinion, and Publish review. Published reviews are public.
A prefilled review form with an updated rating and opinion, and Publish changes.
Reading progress with On this device as the new tracking mode and Track progress.
Reading progress showing a current position earlier than the furthest tracked section.
Reset tracking and Stop tracking, followed by the end-of-book Finish action. Completion requires choosing Finish.
Account settings showing Not connected and Connect account.
Separate sharing choices for reading lists and finished books.
